title: Tiramisu
description: A classic Italian dessert of coffee-soaked ladyfingers layered with creamy mascarpone and dusted with cocoa.
instructions: Whip the heavy cream with the sugar and vanilla until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold the mascarpone into the whipped cream until smooth.
Quickly dip each ladyfinger in the cooled coffee and line the bottom of a dish with a layer.
Spread half of the mascarpone mixture over the ladyfingers.
Repeat with another layer of dipped ladyfingers and the remaining mixture.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, ideally overnight, before serving.
Dust with cocoa powder just before serving.
